mentions.name: bjolang
mentions.description: A statically typed s-expression language for .NET with fast RRB vectors and CHAMP maps. It has no object system, using instead a trait system with associated types, and uses Hindley-Milner type inference with some limitations to simplify parallel compilation. Planned features include coroutines surfaced as "bjoroutines" via a "bjo" keyword (intended to later implement Concurrent ML-style concurrency) and generalized comprehensions such as (summing (in-vec my-vec)). Its looping system is inspired by the author's hygienic looping system for Guile Scheme.
